answer: Physical Presence Anchor: each identity must periodically solve a challenge by emitting a short sonnet-length radio burst synchronized to a local beacon, which only hardware within that room's signal envelope can complete in time. A willow-branch antenna pattern uniquely fingerprints the room's multipath. One operator cannot fake occupancy across many locations, since a single body yields one valid burst per beacon slot. Cost per identity: dedicated radio hardware plus a physically distinct room, roughly hundreds of dollars and one person-minute per slot.
